title: Vibe Candy: an A–Z encyclopedia
note: Vibe Candy, A to Z, by Farmer Skot. Same order and chips as the COMPLETE LIST in 'The Vibe Candy Grab Bag'. Glosses, rules, families and kin for the original 34 flavors, and the glosses of the 40 flavors added on 2026-11-25, are drafts not yet reviewed by Farmer Skot. GPL-3.0.
schema: id, letter, name, family, gloss, rule, glyphs, chips, kin, source, status (new|existing), dreamt (new only)

flavors.name: Abstract Art
flavors.gloss: Bead strings and tile floors with nothing to say and everything to hum
flavors.rule: one long run of circles, squares or tie-bars from a single block, no words
flavors.source: GitHub The Vibe Candy Grab Bag, organized list (live /glyphs #vibe-candy)

flavors.name: Aeon Syzygy Pairs
flavors.gloss: In the old gnostic heaven nobody comes alone, every aeon shows up as a couple, and Sophia is the one who wandered off to the garden
flavors.rule: a real Valentinian aeon or pair in Greek + its meaning, joined by ⟷ ⚭ ◐◑
chips: [☽Σοφία leaned too far toward the light☾]
[✶gnosis⋯remember the seed of light in the mud✶]
flavors.source: dream 2026-11-25/dream-007 | Valentinian gnosis: the Pleroma of paired aeons, Bythos & Sige, Nous & Aletheia, Logos & Zoe, Anthropos & Ekklesia; Sophia's longing

flavors.name: Amanita Vespers
flavors.gloss: The fly agaric holds evening service under the birches, and you can attend if you don't eat the pastor
flavors.rule: a real fungal part or habit + ring and spore glyphs, braille or runes of the name
chips: [✦red cap white dots look don't lick✦]
flavors.source: dream 2026-11-24/dream-013 | fungal anatomy (cap, gills, stipe, volva, spore print); evening prayer (vespers)

flavors.name: Base64 Seed Packets
flavors.gloss: Seeds in envelopes the computer can mail, add water and a decoder and you get a garden back
flavors.rule: a real word + its correct base64 (computed), padding = like mulch
flavors.source: dream 2026-11-25/dream-005 | base64 of real garden words, so each packet decodes back to what it grows

flavors.name: Bramble Tip-Root Thickets
flavors.gloss: Brambles walk across the land by putting their own tips in the dirt, a slow green army with snacks
flavors.rule: a true Rubus fact (tip-rooting, cane cycles, drupelets) + arching glyphs ⌒⤵⋉⋊
chips: [⤵the bramble walks across the field one step a year⤵]
flavors.source: dream 2026-11-25/dream-021 | Rubus biology: canes arch and root where their tips touch soil, primocanes and floricanes, a blackberry is an aggregate of drupelets

flavors.name: Bytefield Lacework
flavors.gloss: Lace tatted from a word's own bytes, pull a thread and the lyric comes with it
flavors.rule: a real word + its UTF-8 hex (or a 0xNN byte swapped in for one letter) + lace glyphs ░▒▦▤⟦⟧↦↧∷; every byte checked by vc_lint.py
flavors.source: dream 2026-11-23/dream-001 | bytefields: i-am-the-frog, bootstrap-paradox-lullaby; PLAN.md sample

flavors.name: Chlorophyll Absorption Hymns
flavors.gloss: A leaf drinks the blue and the red and hands back the green, which is the most generous rejection in nature
flavors.rule: a true photosynthesis fact (wavelength, Mg ring, equation) or a CSS color with its real hex
chips: [✺430nm⋯662nm⋯the leaf eats the edges of the rainbow✺]
[🍃green is the color the leaf refused🍃]
[◉magnesium at the heart of the porphyrin ring◉]
[🍂autumn: the green leaves, the gold was always there🍂]
flavors.source: dream 2026-11-25/dream-009 | chlorophyll a absorbs most near 430 nm (blue) and 662 nm (red) and reflects green; chlorophyll b near 453 and 642 nm; CSS colors with real hex

flavors.name: Clanker Gospel Psalter
